title: Warmly Spiced Indian Broad Beans Curry
description: A nutty and snappy date-night dish featuring broad beans in a miso-marinate, cooked to perfection in a tandoor-clay-pot, this low-sodium-friendly curry is a must-try for any occasion
instructions: Preheat the tandoor-clay-pot over medium heat
In a blender, combine miso paste, olive oil, onion, ginger, garlic, cumin seeds, coriander powder, turmeric powder, and salt, and blend until smooth
Add the broad beans to the blender and blend until they are well coated with the marinade
Add the water to the blender and blend until the mixture is well combined
Pour the mixture into the preheated tandoor-clay-pot
Cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the broad beans are tender
Reduce heat to low and simmer for an additional 10 minutes
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired
